outcome: Group B Streptococcus (GBS) transmission rate to neonates
Comparison of PCR and culture methods for detecting GBS colonization
cohort: Healthy infants born to mothers who tested positive for GBS during routine screening
finding: The rate of GBS transmission to neonates was low (3.6% by PCR) and there was no significant difference in detection rates between PCR and culture methods.
mod_finding: The GBS transmission rate was 2.4% among vaginal deliveries and 4.8% among cesarean deliveries.
